s1.syndrome_frame: Cardiac dysfunction with possible infiltrative or obstructive process in the setting of a history of malignancy
salient_findings: Prolonged P-wave duration and abnormal P wave morphology on ECG
Diffuse masses in the right atrium on echocardiogram
key_facts: Patient is in their 70s
History of diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
Treated with 8 courses of chemotherapy 4 years ago
No history of structural heart disease or hypertension
Blood pressure is 96/54 mm Hg
Heart rate is 56 bpm
Serum troponin I is 0.04 ng/mL
NT-proBNP is 3896.83 pg/mL
ECG shows prolonged P-wave duration and abnormal P wave morphology
Transthoracic echocardiogram reveals diffuse masses in the right atrium
PET-CT scan shows increased metabolic activity along the right atrial myocardium and adjacent pericardium

shortlist.label: Cardiac lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: History of diffuse large B-cell lymphoma and evidence of cardiac masses on echocardiogram

shortlist.label: Secondary cardiac tumor
shortlist.why_kept: History of malignancy and evidence of increased metabolic activity on PET-CT scan

shortlist.label: Right atrial myxoma
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of diffuse masses in the right atrium on echocardiogram

shortlist.label: Cardiac sarcoidosis
shortlist.why_kept: Abnormal ECG findings and evidence of cardiac dysfunction

shortlist.label: Lymphomatous pericarditis
shortlist.why_kept: History of lymphoma and evidence of pericardial involvement on PET-CT scan

raw.rationale: The patient's history of diffuse large B-cell lymphoma and the presence of diffuse masses in the right atrium on the transthoracic echocardiogram, along with increased metabolic activity on the PET-CT scan, strongly suggest cardiac involvement of the lymphoma.

rejected.label: Secondary cardiac tumor
rejected.why: While possible, the presence of lymphoma masses in the heart is more directly related to the patient's history of lymphoma than a secondary tumor.

rejected.label: Right atrial myxoma
rejected.why: The description of diffuse masses and increased metabolic activity is not typical for a myxoma, which is usually a single, benign tumor.

rejected.label: Cardiac sarcoidosis
rejected.why: There is no mention of granulomatous disease or other signs of sarcoidosis, making this diagnosis less likely.

rejected.label: Lymphomatous pericarditis
rejected.why: While the patient has a history of lymphoma, the primary issue appears to be intracardiac masses rather than pericardial disease.
